01 About

People-first recruiting,
engineered for tech.

10+ years of full-cycle recruitment in high-growth SaaS, IT and fintech companies. I’ve recruited talent all over the globe — mainly, but not only, for technical positions.

Today I’m an HR Business Partner and Senior Technical Recruiter at finbyte in Berlin, running technical recruitment for the fintech ecosystem. I’m passionate about technology and about giving candidates and hiring managers the best recruiting experience possible — in English, German, Turkish or Dutch.

They’re found.

    04 Process

    From brief to signed offer.

    A structured, transparent pipeline — so hiring managers get the right people and candidates always know where they stand.

    1. Step 1

      Intake & job analysis

      Align with hiring managers on outcomes and must-haves — and write a job description engineers actually want to read.

    2. Step 2

      Proactive sourcing

      Boolean search, headhunting, referrals and talent communities to reach passive candidates worldwide.

    3. Step 3

      Screening & interviews

      CV screening and structured, fair interviews with clear scorecards at every stage.

    4. Step 4

      Assessment & references

      Pre-employment testing and reference checks that validate skills — not just CVs.

    5. Step 5

      Offer & onboarding

      Transparent offers, relocation support and a smooth first day. Great candidate experience until the very end.
